activity_context.topic_title: Applying the Addition Law With Event Complements

feedback.worked_solution:
First, we calculate $P(A\cap B)$ using the addition law:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(A\cup B) & =P(A)+P(B)-P(A\cap B) \\ 0.6 & =0.25+0.45-P(A\cap B) \\ P(A\cap B) & =0.25+0.45-0.6 \\  & =0.1\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we construct the corresponding Venn diagram and shade the region $A\cup {B}^{′}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14064054/assets/f8fb716593a35fc1f85ab524dc78bf0fa0cd03dc16b0c5ca92a9b2836e6e7c5b.png)

Finally, we have

$$
P(A\cup {B}^{′})=0.15+0.1+0.4=0.65.
$$
